nodes.label: Milestone A Executable Plan
nodes.rationale: Task-by-task TDD plan delivering everything Milestone A promises; demo scripts run against the LOCAL Supabase stack only (never Seoul, where credit_ledger is append-only), live migrations via CLI db push.

nodes.label: scripts/demo/lib.ts local-only helper
nodes.rationale: Refuses anything that isn't 127.0.0.1; T1 shipped with sqlLocal (direct pg connection) replacing psqlLocal (docker exec) because spawnSync docker times out from nested child processes in sandboxed harnesses.

nodes.label: seed-demo.ts fixture
nodes.rationale: Idempotent seed: operator, practitioner, Clinical Update Seminar 2026 as draft (start now+45min so registration+check-in windows overlap mid-demo), 6 attendees.

nodes.label: render-emails.ts
nodes.rationale: Renders confirmation + reminder; reminder's cid: image swapped for a data-URI QR because a browser can't show cid attachments.

nodes.label: ledger-demo.ts trust-moment driver
nodes.rationale: declare_licence to verify_licence to self_check_in to record_credit_entry; service-role UPDATE blocked (42501); superuser tamper caught by the ledger verifier - the demo's differentiator moment.

nodes.label: CI replay-and-verify harness
nodes.rationale: Throwaway local stack: supabase db reset (all migrations + seed) then assert both chain verifiers green, tamper the first probe row, expect detection; GitHub Actions job runs it on push/PR.

nodes.label: set_staff_role() audited definer function
nodes.rationale: Column-level revoke update(role) so fixture INSERTs keep working but role changes become definer-only; writes staff_role_changed audit event LAST; negative test asserts SQLSTATE 42501 specifically.

nodes.label: Residual grant hygiene batch
nodes.rationale: revoke all from public then re-grant intended roles for self_check_in/require_active_staff/pseudonymise_user, ending with a self-verifying DO block asserting the has_function_privilege matrix; plus fail-loud fixture cleanup (mustDelete).

nodes.label: Collateral drafts (CPD Ledger naming)
nodes.rationale: One-pager + trust one-pager + outreach email; the word Passport appears nowhere (Q29).

nodes.label: Phase-completion protocol (three lenses + backtest)
nodes.rationale: Dev-lens + separate user-lens + security-reviewer agent (Tasks 9-10), then backtest; grant matrix re-verified against LIVE proacl queries, never migration text.

nodes.label: Hard Rule 11 grant posture
nodes.rationale: Audited-mutation tables revoke direct writes at the grant level (service_role included, since it has BYPASSRLS); proven by a negative test asserting 42501.
